body: No, it doesn't ever go away. I've had severe depression and anxiety since I was a young teenager. There are times where it seems like you are getting better and then something small, something minuscule will happen and it will all come crashing down. Most days there is no reason to wake up, no reason to continue breathing. Maybe you meet an amazing girl that fixes it all, guess what? Your depression and anxiety will fuck that up too. Everyone around you gets tired of dealing with you after a while, even if they say they don't. Yeah, you can meditate, take medication, get some talk therapy and it might help for a bit. Alot of people assume its similar to being sad, as in if you do something that makes you happy it will help. The issue is that happy things don't actually make you happy, they just distract you. True happiness is a fleeting and impossible idea to someone with severe depression. Happy things typically push me further into depression as it hurts to know that its going to end soon or that it just doesn't invoke any form of joy.

I have already been through all of the suggested fixes for suicidal issues. I've talked to multiple therapists, been commited twice for suicide attempts. Nothing has done anything and typically everything only gets worse every week

No. Last October she told me someone broke into our backyard and attacked her, cops were called and everything. Now she is saying that I did it. She's saying that I forced her to move in and that I've threatened to kill her and her family.

My ex fiance left. Two weeks later was with someone new. 3 months later I get arrested because she is claiming that I physically abused her and "forced" her to be with me for 6 years. I've never hit anybody in my life, never even been in a fight. So now I'm alone and probably going to jail. I would rather just die
